operation.summary: This phone's display right now and the canvas a card's page gets: full screen (presentation full_screen) per orientation and the standard card frame. Static specs (screen size, cameras) are also stored with Bridgit: ask GET <team backend>/v1/names/{name}/specs first when the phone may be busy or offline
operation.returns: width_px, height_px (the full display in its current rotation), density_dpi, density, aspect_ratio (long:short, e.g. 20:9), rotation (0, 90, 180 or 270), orientation (portrait or landscape), refresh_hz, full_screen_card {portrait {width_px, height_px}, landscape {width_px, height_px}} (the whole display less the camera cutout; compose full-screen images to this size), standard_card {width_px, height_px, measured} (the bordered card frame; measured false = estimated from the window)
